# Rhizomatics

> Open source software for Home Assistant, MQTT, Docker self-hosting, and marine SignalK
> integrations.

Rhizomatics is an open source organisation publishing free, source-available tools that
integrate with Home Assistant, MQTT brokers, Docker, and the SignalK marine data standard. All
projects are hosted on GitHub at https://github.com/rhizomatics. The Rhizomatics website is at
https://www.rhizomatics.org.uk.

## Home Assistant & self-hosting

- [AutoArm](https://autoarm.rhizomatics.org.uk): Automatically arm Home Assistant alarm panels
  using calendars, presence, mobile actions, sun state and conditions.
- [Supernotify](https://supernotify.rhizomatics.org.uk): Unified notification for Home Assistant,
  with chimes, voice announcements, camera snapshots and PTZ camera movements.
- [Updates2MQTT](https://updates2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk): Use Home Assistant's Updates dialog for
  self-hosted Docker container updates, with one-click pull and restart.
- [anpr2mqtt](https://anpr2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk): Integrate ANPR/ALPR cameras via the file
  system, creating Home Assistant entities for plate reads, with optional UK DVLA lookup.
- [Remote Logger](https://github.com/rhizomatics/remote_logger): OTEL and syslog native remote
  structured logging for Home Assistant.
- [Awesome MQTT](https://github.com/rhizomatics/awesome-mqtt): A curated list of MQTT brokers,
  clients, tools and resources.

## Sailing & SignalK

- [signalk-cli](https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-cli): Command line access to SignalK APIs.
- [signalk-datalab-plugin](https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-datalab-plugin): Interactive
  data analysis notebooks for SignalK, running as WebAssembly in the browser.
- [Boat Tech Directory](https://boat-tech-directory.rhizomatics.org.uk): A curated directory of
  boat tech covering NMEA and Seatalk, marine internet, open source projects, hardware vendors
  and educational resources.
- [Awesome Boat Tech](https://github.com/SY-Sea-Jade/awesome-boat-tech): The same curated list of
  boat tech, in 'awesome list' format.
- [signalk-bluetti-plugin](https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-bluetti-plugin): Reads Bluetti
  power station sensor data for battery level, solar input, inverter and more, with configuration
  for dozens of models.
- [signalk-delta-squelch-plugin](https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-delta-squelch-plugin):
  Minimizes noisy SignalK deltas and unnecessary database space/query time for analytics.
- [signalk-einklabel-plugin](https://rhizomatics.github.io/signalk-einklabel-plugin/): Publishes
  SignalK data to cheap eInk electronic shelf labels over BLE, with simple SVG templating and
  scheduling. Also available as
  [signalk-einklabel-genai-plugin](https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-einklabel-genai-plugin)
  to generate ESL labels from a configurable LLM prompt.
- [signalk-teltonika-sms-plugin](https://github.com/rhizomatics/signalk-teltonika-sms-plugin):
  Notifications API implementation for text messaging, sending SMS via the Web API on Teltonika
  RutOS modems/routers.
